description: Compact semantic fingerprint for a single hex colour. This is one component of colour_passport. Returns the fingerprint format alone; colour_passport returns the general colour profile that includes it. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.
name: colour_dna

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Colour DNA Fingerprint
